reply_body: You're saying two charges went out on the same day for the plan renewal. On our side only one renewal charge is showing, but I don't want to leave it at that — your account and card records are going to our billing team so they can check both against what your bank is showing. If you can send a screenshot of the two entries from your statement, that will speed up the check.
summary: User reports being charged twice the same day; records show a single renewal capture and no close-together captures.
